correctness.rationale: The exact transfer function is a positive parallel sum. Its phase derivative has a positive denominator and a quadratic numerator C+B x+A x^2 in x=(a omega)^2 with A,C>0. The discriminant factors as (r-m)(m-1)(r+1)Q_r(m), while B+Q_r(m)=-6rm. These two identities prove derivative sign reversals are equivalent to Q_r(m)>0. Q_r is a concave quadratic with discriminant (r-1)^2(r^2-14r+1), yielding the exact 7+4 sqrt(3) threshold and mixing interval. All endpoints and the horizontal-tangent equality cases are settled. The packaged SymPy checker reproduced 879 exact and numerical assertions, but the real-variable theorem relies on the written proof.

value.rationale: The planetary heat-storage inverse problem is motivated by the source demonstration that unresolved ocean/land mixing masks inferred thermal lag. This result supplies the exact universal relaxation-time separation needed even to permit a frequency-lag reversal, as well as the full mixing interval and exactly two turning frequencies. The sharp all-parameter boundary distinguishes homogeneous effective-inertia behavior from an explicitly misleading mixed response; it is not a routine single-pole formula nor an empirical detection claim.
